description: Defines context-triggered system voice lines (menu focus/select, tutorial, story, title logo) as weighted candidate sets with delay and progress-flag gating.

Id.technical: FName primary key. StoryChapter.Id_PlayVoice_OnOpenMissionSelect, Id_PlayVoice_StartDialog and Id_PlayVoice_OnSelectMission, and GameManager.StudioStoryRequestName_CEC, are used to look up rows in DTM.PlayVoiceDataTables (+0x760). Export keys are numeric strings (for example "50").

PlayVoiceType.simple: UI/game event that triggers this voice definition.
PlayVoiceType.technical: EGamePlayVoiceType (None default) cast to uint8 and compared with the requested VoiceId in PlaySystemVoice; VoiceId 0 is rejected outright. Rows are also filtered by this enum for the sound-volume sample voice (Title_TitleLogo_OnFinishLogoAnimation) and searched by type in lobby/story character-select code. The enum names encode screen and event, such as MainMenu_Story_OnFocus or Story_Tutorial_OnAchieveTask.

PlayIndexOrder.simple: Ordering/grouping key for voice variations that play in sequence.
PlayIndexOrder.technical: int32, default 0. Collected rows are grouped by this key; groups are stable-sorted ascending by key. Within a group, Id_Voice and Weights_VoiceLottery arrays from later rows are appended. The first group determines the lottery variation, DelayTime and the order in which one voice per group is queued.

DelayTime.simple: Seconds to wait before the queued voice sequence starts.
DelayTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f, but exported rows often use -1.0f. Only the lowest PlayIndexOrder group is consulted: DelayTime >= 0 is used verbatim, otherwise the player default (0.15f set at GameManager boot) is used. SetQueue clamps the countdown to >= 0.

UserProgressFlag.simple: Save-data condition controlling whether the row is eligible.
UserProgressFlag.technical: int32, constructor default 0; negative means "no condition". A zero-or-greater value indexes UserInfo.UserProgressFlagWords by Flag>>2 and bit Flag&3; the row is eligible only when that bit is set and the word index is below 128. The sound-volume sample picker uses the same test (negative counts as set) to filter title-logo rows.

Id_Voice.simple: Candidate VoiceDataTable IDs for this voice event.
Id_Voice.technical: TArray<FName>. A variation index is chosen from the first group's weights (or supplied by the caller), then VoiceIds[variation] is taken from every group in PlayIndexOrder; None and out-of-range entries are skipped. Each ID is resolved against VoiceDataTables (+0x740) and the resulting cue sheet/cue is queued. Story character-select uses the array directly to find the pair-character voice whose ID contains the character ID.

Weights_VoiceLottery.simple: Per-candidate weights for choosing the voice variation.
Weights_VoiceLottery.technical: TArray<float>, parallel to Id_Voice (no length validation observed; arrays are appended when rows are grouped). GameSound_PickWeightedIndex rolls Sum(Weights)*StoryFRand(), walks weights in order subtracting until Roll < weight, and returns that index; an empty list returns -1 (no voice). Exported rows use 100.0 for active candidates and 0.0 for None placeholders.

notes: Loaded as a DataTable primary asset named PlayVoiceDataTable into DTM.PlayVoiceDataTables (+0x760).
This table defines variation sets, not a single line: the chosen variation index is shared across all PlayIndexOrder groups, enabling sequences such as a title-logo voice followed by another line.
The config sound-volume screen uses the same table only to pick a sample title-logo voice; the main consumer is UGameSoundVoicePlayer::PlaySystemVoice(uint8 VoiceId, int32 Variation).
The companion export contains 181 rows; retail completeness and Blueprint-only references are not asserted. Source is reconstructed retail C++ with retail RVAs recorded inline.

usages.detail: PlaySystemVoice filters by type/flag, groups by order, chooses a variation and queues voices.
Builds the sample-voice lottery from title-logo rows.
Picks a lobby voice variation from rows of the online-lobby focus type.
Finds the pair-character voice row and index by character ID.
Resolves the story request voice row and plays its type.
Reads PlayVoiceType of the chapter select-mission voice row.
